CHAPTER II - HIJUTSUS
Bakuton (Explosion Release)
Power and Limited Abilities
Bakuton is an advanced bloodline formed through the simultaneous use of Earth and
Lightning elements to create explosions. Its origin stems from Iwagakure, specifically
from the troop known as the "Explosion Corps." Its use is a combination of ninjutsu and...
Taijutsu was used to create a particularly offensive and disruptive fighting style.
Restricted Skills: Demolition.
Restricted Power: Bakuton (Explosion Element).

DEMOLITION
You have mastered the art of demolishing structures with your Bakuton.
Prerequisite: Bakuton 5
Benefit: When attacking with any Bakuton technique, your techniques ignore 2 hardness
points of any object, barrier, or imaginary hardness targeted by the user, except those
created by other Bakuton techniques, if the user so desires. This ability does not affect

ignore 3 hardness points.
Level 2: Once you reach Bakuton 8, you can repurchase this skill to evolve it. You can

COMPLETE ARSENAL
You use some kind of shinobi trick to be able to carry a full arsenal of weapons
for missions.
Prerequisites: Use Weapon: Arsenal; Create Weapon or Fuuinjutsu 2
Benefit: You are able to possess a complete arsenal with an infinite number of
non-special weapons occupying little space. How this happens is defined by
the player, whether it's a scroll containing a complete arsenal, like Tenten's, or
a container of liquid metal that molds itself to the character's will, for example.
To use this skill, you must prepare your arsenal at the start of the adventure
and choose how many slots it occupies, 1 or 2. A full 1-slot arsenal is capable
of generating an infinite number of weapons.
A single-compartment arsenal, on the other hand, is capable of generating an infinite number of single-compartment
weapons, whereas a full 2-compartment arsenal is capable of generating an infinite number of 2-compartment weapons.
These slots are not "used up" when weapons are generated. It is possible to
pre-stock the arsenal with poison if the PC possesses this ability.
Generating any weapon from the arsenal costs 1 chakra, and they possess the
same characteristics as their original versions. This action is considered a Draw
Weapon maneuver, costs a partial action, and is affected by the "Quick Draw"
skill.
If the character possesses a unique weapon (such as a special weapon), they
can store it in the "arsenal" at no additional cost, and the weapon will no longer
occupy any of the character's storage slots.
[Requires Dexterity 12]: Weapons derived from this skill become better,
possessing +1 Weapon Damage. Only someone with the "Complete Arsenal"
skill can wield these weapons without penalty.

SUMI NINPOU
Restricted Power
You possess the ability to use a specific style of ninpou based on ink, called Sumi Ninpou.
The player must purchase Sumi Ninpou as a version of the generic Ninpou power, and
must use its rules and the same standards for damage, range, and size of techniques.
Prerequisite: Combat Art.
Key Skill: Art. The parameters of Sumi Ninpou's power, such as range, damage, and
difficulty of saving throws, are calculated based on the Art skill, instead of Spirit.
Range: Long (15m + 3m per Art level). The character can only manipulate or create their
element up to the maximum range of their power.
Size: Creations, manipulations, and areas of effect can have up to 1m in diameter, length,
width, or height per Art level.
Increased Resistance Difficulty: All Sumi Ninpou effects receive a +1 bonus to the
resistance difficulty for target tests.
Reduced Hardness: All techniques and creations of Sumi Ninpou Power possess only
1 Hardness.
Elemental Weakness: Sumi Ninpou's creations and effects are weak against Suiton,
following the Elemental Confrontation rules.
Brush and Ink: Hand seals are not required to use the Sumi Ninpou power. However,
the user must be carrying a brush with ink and have a surface to draw on. Effectively,
you are still affected by the close combat rule. Despite this, you can perform Concentration
tests involving Sumi Ninpou with Art instead of Concentration.
The equipment needed to perform Sumi Ninpou occupies 1 compartment and can be
easily obtained from any settlement that has convenience stores.
Allowed Effects: Cannon(1); Orb(2); Ray(2); Restraint(2); Mount (2; Kibaku Nendo);
Barrier(3); Arrows(3); Spear(3); Ricochet(3); Column(4); Energize(4); Cloud(4);
